ideas.idea: Add Organization/LocalBusiness structured data for phone and address on contact page
ideas.why: Contact page has a phone number as plain text only, so schema would give machines the details directly.

ideas.idea: Add structured data (Offer) for the £40 a night price on moorings
ideas.why: The price appears as a single line of text and structured data would help machines quote it accurately.

ideas.idea: Show FAQ answers as visible text on the home page
ideas.why: The FAQ answers exist only in JSON-LD, which doesn't match visible content, and the report is accurate about this.

ideas.idea: Make the home page an overview linking to /moorings to resolve topic overlap
ideas.why: The overlap between the two pages is modest and the advice is broadly applicable with little effect.

ideas.idea: Use one spelling of Harbor/harbour across title and content
ideas.why: The index title says 'Harbor' while content and the contact page use 'harbour', which is a real inconsistency affecting matching.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags and a <main> element to the layout
ideas.why: Base.astro really lacks charset, viewport and main, and adding them is concrete and cheap.
Accurate, but lastmod on a three-URL sitemap has very little effect.

ideas.idea: Add a site setting in astro.config (site: https://harbor.example)
ideas.why: There is no astro config, and the site setting is needed to build per-page absolute canonicals from Astro.url.

ideas.idea: Add missing Article properties such as author and date to the Article JSON-LD
ideas.why: Accurate but optional properties on a block whose main problem is that it doesn't parse; low effect.

ideas.idea: Layout should list robots defaults explicitly because the prop overwrites the whole value
ideas.why: The report itself says this is fine today, so it has little effect.

ideas.idea: Page for moorings should give sizes and seasonal prices as promised by title and description
ideas.why: The moorings page only has one line of price text while its title and description promise sizes and seasonal prices.
